text_block_list.text:
Inari One got injured during training,
so I took her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're making a big deal over a minor scrape.
Just spit on it and it'll heal right up, I tell ya.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Right, can't be loafing around forever.
Time to get right back to special training.
choice_data_list: Let's make sure to rest properly today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What're you talkin' about? If I say it's fine,
then it's fine.
choice_data_list: Because it'll be too late once something happens...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Good grief, you really are a worrywart, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Geez, lookin' at that gloomy face next to me
is giving me a headache. Fine, I'll take it easy
and rest today, just for you."
With those words, Inari One headed back to the dorm looking rather disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it so much!
Come on, let's get fired up all over again!
I had Inari One do a light run to assess the extent of her injury, but her face twisted in pain.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Damn pain's flared back up...
Not like I can't bear through it, but...
choice_data_list: Let's call it a day here

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*, can't be helped.
It's probably smarter to just keep quiet...
Inari One cut her training short and headed back to the dorms with slumped shoulders...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! How's that, Boss?!
Looks like a light run won't be a problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! How's that, Sis?!
Looks like a light run won't be a problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm a true-blue child of Edo!
A little scratch like this ain't gonna slow me down!
Inari One trained sensibly within a safe range while being mindful of her injury.
